reblog.content_text: 0308 - Vineyards at Machtum29.03.2021This photo was was taken near Nittel, looking across the Moselle towards the Luxembourgish side.Best seen on: https://www.erikproper.eu/highlights/0308#photography #photographer #landscape #nature

media_attachments.description:
From the Nittel, you have a great view towards the vineyards on the Luxembourgish side, close to Machtum.
As spring hadn't started yet, the only green in the vineyards was the gras between the vines, bringing out the lines in the landscape as shown in this highlight
In post, I increasing the contrast to put more stress on the lines in the landscape. Also saturated the green, of the grass.

account.note:
I'm a Dutchman, living in Luxembourg, and working in Vienna, in Austria.
So, I identify as a European.

Photography is my main hobby. I'm lucky in having to travel regularly for work, while also being able to travel the world, and enjoy the beauty of nature, privately.
My main photo website is on: https://www.erikproper.eu/photography

Work-wise, I'm a Professor in Business Informatics at the TU Wien in Austria, while my family life is based in Luxembourg.

reblog.content_text: #fotovorschlag "oben und unten"  A staircase. A play of lines that go van "oben nach unten" and from "unten nach oben"  #abstract #abstractart #abstractphotography #minimalism #photography #photoart #bandw #blackandwhite #monochrome #blackandwhitephotography #abstractphoto

media_attachments.description: A black and white photograph of a tall building's staircase, behind glass. Photographed from the outside and from below. A play of straight and diagonal lines. Three stone steps running from bottom left to top right, with narrow parallel smal black lines between them from railings, on the background of the sunlit wall of the staircase. Then, diagonally from top left to bottom right, small lines from the window jambs in the glass in front of them, and two window jambs running straight from bottom to top.
